# Five-Year Interest-free Prize Bonds, 1965, shown in the Schedule appended hereto have won the prizes indicated against them at the sixth quarterly draw for prizes held on 1st December, 1961.

MINISTRY OF FINANCE (Department of Economic Affairs) New Delhi, the 6th December, 1961 NOTIFICATION No. F.25(13)-NS/61.—In pursuance of paragraph 7 of the Notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of.Finance (Department of Economic Affairs) No. F.4(l)-W&M/60, dated the 1st March, 1960, it is hereby notified for general information that the Five-Year Interest-free Prize Bonds, 1965, shown in the Schedule appended hereto have won the prizes indicated against them at the sixth quarterly draw for prizes held on 1st December, 1961.

SHIV NAUBH SINGH, Jt. Secy.
